_doc: Engine-specific failures the rendered checks report as warnings instead of failures. One list per engine; each entry is { "script", "match", "reason" }: script is v5_audit, core_regressions, screenshots or a11y, and match is a regular expression tested against the failure key that script documents (see test/README.md, "Engines and known issues"). Keep every entry narrow (name the theme/page/check) and give a reason with a link to the browser bug where there is one; delete it when the engine is fixed.
